column1: # Liquid nitrogen from the NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69 (https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/fluid/), retrieved 2026-10-14:
# the equation of state of Span, Lemmon, Jacobsen, Wagner and Yokozeki (2000) and the viscosity of Lemmon and Jacobsen (2004), as the WebBook prints them (six digits).
# One block per isotherm: first the saturated liquid at the vapour pressure (with the saturated vapour's density), then the compressed liquid
# from 0.001 bar over the vapour pressure in steps of 2.5 bar, to 262.5 bar over it or to the melting line; at 68.561 K, where the melting
# pressure passes the tube's first-yield pressure, one more row just above that pressure, at 254.14 bar.
# Columns: temperature K, pressure bar, density kg/m^3, speed of sound m/s, viscosity uPa s, saturated vapour density kg/m^3 (saturation rows only, else 0).
